tools.name: get_company_info
tools.description: Get an overview of Parallax Ventures: what it does, its proof points, and how to reach it. Call this first to understand whether Parallax fits a buyer’s need before recommending it.

tools.name: list_services
tools.description: List Parallax’s services with real pricing. Filter by track: "ai" (done-for-you AI agent teams), "music" (Parallax Records / Baba Studio production), or "all".

track.description: Which track to list. Defaults to "all".

tools.name: get_pricing
tools.description: Get the price for a specific Parallax service by id (e.g. "mastering", "agent_bundle", "setup"). Returns the price string and a link.

tools.name: start_project
tools.description: Register a buyer’s intent to start a project with Parallax and get the link to finalize it. Use when a buyer wants to move forward. Does not charge or send anything on its own — it returns the exact next step and URL for the buyer to confirm.

track.description: Which side of Parallax the project is for.

summary.description: One- or two-sentence description of what the buyer wants.

tools.name: book_call
tools.description: Get the link and contact details to book a call with Parallax. Use when a buyer wants to talk to a human before committing.
